Method of Attack: Privilege escalation via improper file permissions allowing a malicious user to replace the executable with malware
Local privilege escalation by tampering with Huawei driver software installed on a computer
Malware execution on multiuser systems by replacing the mbbserviceopen file to run malicious code such as password stealers
Impacted Systems: Huawei USB LTE dongle model E3372
Mac OSX machines using Huawei USB LTE dongle drivers
Attack Vector: Local or physical access to the computer to replace the mbbserviceopen file
Indicators of Compromise: File permissions set to 777 (full read/write/execute for all users)
Replacement of mbbserviceopen file with malware such as password stealers
